ts
import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from '../templates/social/examples/App.vue';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const apps: ReturnType<typeof createOwnerApp>[] = [];
	const createApp: typeof createOwnerApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};

	const application = createApp(App);
	const view = application.mount(element);
	if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('test'))
		Object.assign(window, { socialDemo: { view, application } });

	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}
ts
let sequence = 0;
let fallbackPrefix: string | undefined;

/** 模板的操作关联ID和行键；不依赖DOM或安全上下文，也不用于安全凭据。 */
export function createTemplateId(): string {
	const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
	if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
	if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues === 'function') {
		const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
		bytes[6] = (bytes[6]! & 0x0f) | 0x40;
		bytes[8] = (bytes[8]! & 0x3f) | 0x80;
		const hex = [...bytes].map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
		return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
	}
	// 无Web Crypto的SSR宿主仍能创建本模块内独立关联键，不在导入时访问浏览器对象。
	fallbackPrefix ??= `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
	return `asam-${fallbackPrefix}-${(++sequence).toString(36)}`;
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type { AsamCardLayout, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { FullScreen, Grid, List, Plus, ScaleToOriginal } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import type { ListToolbarTool } from './ListToolbarTypes.js';

const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<{
		label: string;
		summary?: string;
		size?: AsamControlSize;
		createLabel?: string;
		createDisabled?: boolean;
		tools?: readonly ListToolbarTool[];
		viewDisabled?: boolean;
		wide?: boolean;
		layout?: AsamCardLayout;
	}>(),
	{ wide: undefined }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{
	create: [];
	action: [id: string];
	'update:wide': [wide: boolean];
	'update:layout': [layout: AsamCardLayout];
}>();
const i18n = useAsamProI18n();
const labels = computed(() =>
	i18n.locale.value.startsWith('en')
		? {
				shrink: 'Use constrained width',
				widen: 'Use full width',
				horizontal: 'Switch to horizontal layout',
				vertical: 'Switch to vertical layout'
			}
		: {
				shrink: '切为窄版',
				widen: '铺满内容区',
				horizontal: '切为横向排列',
				vertical: '切为纵向排列'
			}
);
const actions = computed<readonly ListToolbarTool[]>(() => {
	const items = [...(props.tools ?? [])];
	if (props.wide !== undefined) {
		items.push({
			id: 'width',
			label: props.wide ? labels.value.shrink : labels.value.widen,
			icon: props.wide ? ScaleToOriginal : FullScreen,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: props.wide
		});
	}
	if (props.layout) {
		const vertical = props.layout === 'list';
		items.push({
			id: 'layout',
			label: vertical ? labels.value.horizontal : labels.value.vertical,
			icon: vertical ? Grid : List,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: vertical
		});
	}
	return items;
});
function activate(tool: ListToolbarTool) {
	if (tool.disabled || tool.ariaDisabled) return;
	if (tool.id === 'width' && props.wide !== undefined) emit('update:wide', !props.wide);
	else if (tool.id === 'layout' && props.layout)
		emit('update:layout', props.layout === 'list' ? 'grid' : 'list');
	else emit('action', tool.id);
}
</script>

import type { Component } from 'vue';

export interface ListToolbarTool {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly label: string;
	readonly icon: Component;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
	readonly ariaDisabled?: boolean;
	readonly pressed?: boolean;
	readonly state?: 'default-sort';
}
ts
import type { AsamListRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	SocialComment,
	SocialId,
	SocialOperation,
	SocialOutcome,
	SocialPage,
	SocialPost,
	SocialRequest,
	SocialService
} from './Types.js';

/** Replace transport and both explicit DTO mappings; no package-source alias or service singleton. */
export function adaptSocial<P, C>(
	transport: {
		feed: (query: AsamListRequest, request: SocialRequest) => Promise<SocialPage<P>>;
		comments: (
			id: SocialId,
			page: number,
			size: number,
			request: SocialRequest
		) => Promise<SocialPage<C>>;
		write: (
			op: SocialOperation,
			request: SocialRequest
		) => Promise<
			Exclude<SocialOutcome, { status: 'success' }> | { status: 'success'; post: P }
		>;
		resolve: (
			id: string,
			request: SocialRequest
		) => Promise<
			Exclude<SocialOutcome, { status: 'success' }> | { status: 'success'; post: P }
		>;
	},
	mapping: { post: (dto: P) => SocialPost; comment: (dto: C) => SocialComment }
): SocialService {
	const result = (
		value: Exclude<SocialOutcome, { status: 'success' }> | { status: 'success'; post: P }
	): SocialOutcome =>
		value.status === 'success' ? { status: 'success', post: mapping.post(value.post) } : value;
	return {
		feed: async (q, r) => {
			const p = await transport.feed(q, r);
			return { total: p.total, list: p.list.map(mapping.post) };
		},
		comments: async (id, n, s, r) => {
			const p = await transport.comments(id, n, s, r);
			return { total: p.total, list: p.list.map(mapping.comment) };
		},
		write: async (op, r) => result(await transport.write(op, r)),
		resolve: async (id, r) => result(await transport.resolve(id, r))
	};
}

css
.social-page {
	--social-ink: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #292c2b);
	--social-paper: var(--asam-color-surface-page);
	--social-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--social-line: var(--asam-color-border, #e4e3df);
	--social-accent: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	--social-control: 36px;
	color: var(--social-ink);
	background: var(--social-paper);
	padding: 40px;
	font: 15px/1.65 var(--asam-typography-font-family);
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.social-page[data-size='large'] {
	--social-control: 40px;
}
.social-page[data-size='default'] {
	--social-control: 32px;
}
.social-page[data-size='small'] {
	--social-control: 28px;
}
.social-page *,
.social-demo * {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.social-page h1,
.social-page h2,
.social-page h3,
.social-page p {
	margin-top: 0;
}
.social-page h1 {
	font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 64px);
	line-height: 1.1;
	letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}
.social-page
	:is(
		button:not([class*='el-']),
		input:not([class*='el-']),
		select:not([class*='el-']),
		textarea
	):not(:where(.social-query *, .template-list-toolbar *, .social-post-action)) {
	font: inherit;
	color: inherit;
	border: 1px solid var(--social-line);
	background: var(--social-surface);
	border-radius: 4px;
	min-height: var(--social-control);
	padding: 4px 10px;
	max-width: 100%;
}
/* One 15px line, padding and borders must fit the 28px native-control size.
   Textareas retain the prose line height and their independent multiline minimum. */
.social-page
	:is(button:not([class*='el-']), input:not([class*='el-']), select):not(
		:where(.social-query *, .template-list-toolbar *, .social-post-action)
	) {
	line-height: 1.2;
}
.social-page
	select:not([class*='el-']):not(
		:where(.social-query *, .template-list-toolbar *, .social-post-action)
	) {
	height: var(--social-control);
	padding-block: 0;
}
.social-page
	button:not([class*='el-']):not(
		:where(.social-query *, .template-list-toolbar *, .social-post-action)
	) {
	cursor: pointer;
	transition:
		transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
		opacity 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.social-page
	button:not([class*='el-']):not(
		:where(.social-query *, .template-list-toolbar *, .social-post-action)
	):active {
	transform: scale(0.98);
}
.social-page
	button:not([class*='el-']):not(
		:where(.social-query *, .template-list-toolbar *, .social-post-action)
	):disabled {
	cursor: default;
	opacity: 0.5;
}
.social-page :focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.social-page label:not(:where(.social-query *)) {
	display: grid;
	gap: 4px;
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
}
.social-page > *,
.social-editorial > *,
.social-brand-shell > *,
.social-tech-layout > * {
	min-width: 0;
}
.social-page
	select:not([class*='el-']):not(
		:where(.social-query *, .template-list-toolbar *, .social-post-action)
	) {
	min-width: 0;
}
.social-page figure {
	margin: 10px 0;
}
.social-page img {
	max-width: 100%;
	max-height: 180px;
	object-fit: contain;
}
.social-page figcaption,
.social-page small {
	font-size: 12px;
}
.social-page .social-avatar img {
	width: 40px;
	height: 40px;
}
.social-page dl {
	margin: 0;
}
.social-page dd {
	margin: 0 0 18px;
}
.social-page dt {
	font-size: 11px;
	letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.social-feed {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-lg);
}
.social-body {
	white-space: pre-wrap;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.social-preview {
	display: -webkit-box;
	-webkit-line-clamp: 4;
	-webkit-box-orient: vertical;
	overflow: hidden;
}
.social-index {
	font:
		11px/1.4 Consolas,
		monospace;
}
.social-page .asam-list-item {
	animation: social-enter 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
	background: var(--social-surface);
	color: var(--social-ink);
}
.social-page .asam-list-actions {
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 8px;
}
.social-page .asam-list-items {
	min-width: 0;
}
.social-action-label {
	position: absolute;
	width: 1px;
	height: 1px;
	padding: 0;
	margin: -1px;
	overflow: hidden;
	clip-path: inset(50%);
	white-space: nowrap;
}
/* The editable page owns its skin; bridge it into borrowed list/control text tokens. */
.social-page .asam-lists {
	--asam-color-text-primary: var(--social-ink);
	--asam-color-text-regular: var(--social-ink);
	--asam-color-surface: var(--social-surface);
	--el-text-color-primary: var(--social-ink);
	--el-text-color-regular: var(--social-ink);
	--el-text-color-secondary: var(--social-ink);
	--el-text-color-placeholder: var(--social-ink);
	--el-bg-color: var(--social-surface);
	--el-fill-color-blank: var(--social-surface);
	--el-fill-color-light: var(--social-paper);
	--el-border-color: var(--social-line);
	--el-border-color-light: var(--social-line);
}
.social-page .asam-list-source pre {
	max-width: 100%;
	white-space: pre-wrap;
}
.social-detail {
	border-top: 2px solid var(--social-accent);
	margin-top: 40px;
	padding: 24px 0;
}
.social-detail header {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 12px;
}
.social-detail form {
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.social-detail textarea:not([class*='el-']) {
	width: 100%;
	min-height: 120px;
}
.social-comments {
	list-style: none;
	padding: 0;
}
.social-comments li {
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--social-line);
	margin-bottom: 20px;
	padding-bottom: 20px;
}
.social-comments small {
	display: block;
}
.social-detail nav {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 8px;
}
.social-detail [role='alertdialog'] {
	border: 2px solid var(--social-accent);
	padding: 20px;
	margin-top: 20px;
}
.social-masthead {
	max-width: 1120px;
	margin: 20px auto 36px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--social-line);
	padding-bottom: 28px;
}
.social-masthead h1 {
	font-family: Georgia, 'Songti SC', serif;
	max-width: 700px;
	margin: 24px 0;
	font-weight: 400;
}
.social-editorial {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 200px minmax(0, 760px);
	gap: 60px;
	max-width: 1120px;
	margin: auto;
}
.social-editorial aside {
	font-size: 13px;
}
.social-editorial aside h2 {
	font-size: 17px;
}
.social-minimal .asam-list-item {
	border: 1px solid var(--social-line);
	border-radius: 8px;
	box-shadow: none;
}
.social-brand {
	padding: 28px;
	--social-paper: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);
	--social-accent: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
}
.social-brand-shell {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 210px minmax(0, 1fr) 180px;
	gap: 32px;
	padding: 30px;
	background: var(--social-surface);
	border-radius: 28px;
	box-shadow: 0 12px 50px #24352a08;
}
.social-wordmark {
	display: block;
	font-size: 30px;
	font-weight: 800;
	line-height: 0.95;
	letter-spacing: -0.05em;
	margin-bottom: 60px;
}
.social-brand-sidebar h1 {
	font-size: 24px;
	line-height: 1.4;
}
.social-brand-sidebar p {
	font-size: 13px;
	margin: 24px 0 60px;
}
.social-brand-main > header {
	padding: 36px 0 48px;
}
.social-brand-main > header h2 {

	letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}
.social-author-rail {
	font-size: 13px;
	padding-top: 44px;
}
.social-author-rail h2 {
	font-size: 16px;
}
.social-brand .asam-list-item {
	border: none;
	border-radius: 20px;
	background: var(--social-surface);
	box-shadow: none;
	padding: 28px;
}
.social-tech {
	font-family: Consolas, 'Microsoft YaHei', monospace;
	padding: 24px;
}
.social-tech-header {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1fr 180px;
	gap: 32px;
	border-bottom: 3px solid var(--social-accent);
	padding: 30px 0;
}
.social-tech-header h1 {
	font-size: clamp(38px, 7vw, 90px);
	margin: 24px 0;
	font-weight: 900;
}
.social-tech-layout {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(300px, 33%);
	gap: 28px;
	margin-top: 30px;
}
.social-tech-stream > header {
	padding-bottom: 22px;
}
.social-tech h2 {
	font-size: 18px;
}
.social-tech-inspector {
	border-left: 1px solid var(--social-line);
	padding-left: 24px;
}
.social-tech
	:is(
		button:not([class*='el-']),
		input:not([class*='el-']),
		select:not([class*='el-']),
		textarea
	):not(:where(.social-query *, .template-list-toolbar *, .social-post-action)),
.social-tech .asam-list-item {
	border-radius: 0;
}
.social-tech .asam-list-item {
	border: 1px solid var(--social-line);
	box-shadow: none;
}
.social-tech .social-detail {
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.social-demo {
	font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
}
.social-demo-controls {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 12px;
	padding: 16px;
	background: #f7f7f4;
	color: #292c2b;
}
.social-demo-controls button:not([class*='el-']),
.social-demo-controls select:not([class*='el-']) {
	min-height: 36px;
}
@keyframes social-enter {
	from {
		opacity: 0;
		transform: translateY(6px);
	}
	to {
		opacity: 1;
		transform: translateY(0);
	}
}
@media (max-width: 1050px) {
	.social-brand-shell {
		grid-template-columns: 180px minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.social-author-rail {
		grid-column: 2;
	}
	.social-tech-layout {
		grid-template-columns: 1fr;
	}
	.social-tech-inspector {
		border-left: 0;
		padding: 0;
	}
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.social-page {
		padding: 16px;
	}
	.social-editorial,
	.social-brand-shell,
	.social-tech-header {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
		gap: 24px;
	}
	.social-brand-shell {
		padding: 20px;
	}
	.social-author-rail {
		grid-column: auto;
		padding: 0;
	}
	.social-wordmark {
		margin-bottom: 24px;
	}
	.social-brand-sidebar p {
		margin-bottom: 20px;
	}
	.social-masthead {
		margin: 24px 0 36px;
	}

	.social-detail header {
		flex-wrap: wrap;
	}
	.social-page .asam-list-toolbar {
		flex-wrap: wrap;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.social-page *,
	.social-page *::before,
	.social-page *::after {
		animation: none !important;
		transition: none !important;
	}
}

import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n, AsamI18nCall } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createAsamMessageIssue, formatFieldIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { socialMessageDefaults } from './I18n.js';
import { createTemplateId } from '../shared/Id.js';
import { computed, effectScope, readonly, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { comment, idKey, outcome, page, post, validWrite } from './Validation.js';
import { socialPermission } from './Types.js';
import type {
	SocialComment,
	SocialHost,
	SocialId,
	SocialOperation,
	SocialPost,
	SocialRequest,
	SocialWrite
} from './Types.js';

/** Owns only this page's runtime, reads, drafts and operation. Borrowed hosts are never disposed. */
export function createSocial(getHost: () => SocialHost, owner?: AsamI18n) {
	const i18n = owner ? extendAsamI18n(owner, socialMessageDefaults) : undefined;
	const feedbackSource = shallowRef<ReturnType<typeof createAsamMessageIssue>>();
	function setFeedback(legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall | []) {
		feedback.value = legacy;
		feedbackSource.value = call.length ? createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call) : undefined;
	}
	const scope = effectScope();
	let disposed = false,
		epoch = 0,
		selection = 0,
		commentRun = 0;
	const aborts = new Set<AbortController>();
	const clearing = ref(false);
	const authoritative = new Map<string, SocialPost>();
	const revision = ref(0);
	const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({ scope: 'social-page' });
	const selected = shallowRef<SocialPost | null>(null);
	const comments = shallowRef<readonly SocialComment[]>([]);
	const commentPage = ref(1),
		commentTotal = ref(0),
		commentsLoading = ref(false);
	const commentsError = ref(''),
		writeError = ref(''),
		feedback = ref(''),
		draft = ref('');
	const pending = shallowRef<SocialOperation | null>(null);
	const writeStatus = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'failed' | 'unknown'>('idle');
	let stopSecurity = () => {};
	const allowed = (kind: keyof typeof socialPermission) => {
		if (disposed || clearing.value) return false;
		const h = getHost();
		return (
			!disposed &&
			!h.disabled &&
			(!(kind !== 'read' && kind !== 'comments') || !h.readonly) &&
			h.security.check({
				permission: socialPermission[kind],
				write: kind !== 'read' && kind !== 'comments'
			}) === 'allowed'
		);
	};
	const draftInput = computed({
		get: () => draft.value,
		set: (value: string) => {
			if (typeof value === 'string' && selected.value && allowed('comment'))
				draft.value = value;
		}
	});
	function request(kind: keyof typeof socialPermission, signal?: AbortSignal, object?: SocialId) {
		const h = getHost(),
			g = epoch,
			s = selection;
		const subject = h.security.state.value.subject;
		if (!subject || !allowed(kind)) throw Error('当前会话无权操作');
		const key = scopeKey(subject),
			controller = new AbortController();
		aborts.add(controller);
		const cancel = () => controller.abort();
		signal?.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
		if (signal?.aborted) cancel();
		const current = () => {
			const latest = getHost();
			return (
				!disposed &&
				epoch === g &&
				latest.security === h.security &&
				latest.service === h.service &&
				!controller.signal.aborted &&
				allowed(kind) &&
				latest.security.state.value.subject !== null &&
				scopeKey(latest.security.state.value.subject!) === key &&
				(object === undefined || (selection === s && selected.value?.id === object))
			);
		};
		const input: SocialRequest = { subject, signal: controller.signal, isCurrent: current };
		return {
			host: h,
			input,
			current,
			release: () => {
				signal?.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
				aborts.delete(controller);
			}
		};
	}
	function accept(row: SocialPost) {
		const key = idKey(row.id),
			known = authoritative.get(key);
		if (!known || known.version <= row.version) {
			authoritative.set(key, row);
			revision.value++;
		}
		return authoritative.get(key)!;
	}
	const list = scope.run(() =>
		useAsamListController<SocialPost>({
			fields: [
				{ key: 'keyword', label: '关键词', kind: 'text' },
				{ key: 'author', label: '作者', kind: 'single' },
				{ key: 'bookmarked', label: '只看收藏', kind: 'single' }
			],
			initial: { keyword: '', author: '', bookmarked: false },
			queryKeys: ['keyword', 'author', 'bookmarked'],
			rowKey: (row) => idKey(row.id),
			pageSize: 20,
			immediate: false,
			runtime,
			api: async (query, context) => {
				const r = request('read', context.signal);
				try {
					if (!r.current()) throw Error('读取失效');
					const response = await r.host.service.feed(query, r.input);
					if (!r.current()) throw Error('读取失效');
					const result = page(response, post);
					if (!r.current()) throw Error('读取失效');
					if (result.list.length > query.pageSize) throw Error('信息流超过请求页长');
					const rows: SocialPost[] = [];
					for (const row of result.list) {
						const value = accept(row);
						if (!r.current()) throw Error('读取失效');
						rows.push(value);
					}
					return { ...result, list: rows };
				} finally {
					r.release();
				}
			}
		})
	)!;
	const rows = computed(() => {
		void revision.value;
		return list.page.data.value.list.map((row) => authoritative.get(idKey(row.id)) ?? row);
	});
	function clear() {
		// Nested host/security notifications belong to this same cleanup. The outer host
		// watcher resumes the latest host after cleanup; a nested watcher must not reopen it.
		if (clearing.value) return;
		clearing.value = true;
		++epoch;
		++selection;
		++commentRun;
		const old = [...aborts];
		aborts.clear();
		try {
			// Revoke the old result before any local ref notifies synchronous observers.
			runtime.invalidate();
			authoritative.clear();
			selected.value = null;
			comments.value = [];
			draft.value = '';
			pending.value = null;
			writeStatus.value = 'idle';
			commentsError.value = '';
			writeError.value = '';
			setFeedback('');
			commentsLoading.value = false;
			commentTotal.value = 0;
			commentPage.value = 1;
		} finally {
			try {
				old.forEach((c) => c.abort());
			} finally {
				clearing.value = false;
			}
		}
	}
	async function loadComments(targetPage = commentPage.value) {
		if (!Number.isSafeInteger(targetPage) || targetPage < 1) return;
		const row = selected.value;
		if (!row || !allowed('comments')) return;
		const run = ++commentRun,
			r = request('comments', undefined, row.id);
		commentsLoading.value = true;
		commentsError.value = '';
		try {
			if (!r.current() || run !== commentRun) return;
			const value = await r.host.service.comments(row.id, targetPage, 20, r.input);
			if (!r.current() || run !== commentRun) return;
			const result = page(value, (c) => comment(c, row.id));
			if (!r.current() || run !== commentRun) return;
			if (result.list.length > 20) throw Error('评论超过请求页长');
			comments.value = result.list;
			if (!r.current() || run !== commentRun) return;
			commentTotal.value = result.total;
			if (!r.current() || run !== commentRun) return;
			commentPage.value = targetPage;
		} catch {
			if (r.current() && run === commentRun)
				commentsError.value = '评论读取失败，保留原结果，可重试';
		} finally {
			if (r.current() && run === commentRun) commentsLoading.value = false;
			r.release();
		}
	}
	function close() {
		if (disposed || clearing.value) return;
		const token = ++selection;
		++commentRun;
		selected.value = null;
		if (selection !== token) return;
		comments.value = [];
		if (selection !== token) return;
		draft.value = '';
		if (selection !== token) return;
		commentsLoading.value = false;
		if (selection !== token) return;
		commentsError.value = '';
		if (selection !== token) return;
		writeError.value = '';
		if (selection !== token) return;
		commentTotal.value = 0;
		// A submitted operation remains unresolved until explicit lookup, preventing accidental resend.
		if (pending.value) writeStatus.value = 'unknown';
	}
	async function open(row: SocialPost) {
		if (!allowed('read') || !list.resultReady.value || !rows.value.some((p) => p.id === row.id))
			return;
		const token = selection + 1;
		close();
		if (selection !== token || !allowed('read') || !list.resultReady.value) return;
		const currentRow = rows.value.find((p) => p.id === row.id);
		if (!currentRow) return;
		// A delayed UI closure may retain an earlier service's row with the same ID.
		// Only the current result is authoritative; opening never imports caller row data.
		selected.value = post(currentRow);
		if (selection !== token || !allowed('read')) return;
		commentPage.value = 1;
		await loadComments(1);
	}
	async function write(action: SocialWrite, resolving = false) {
		if (!validWrite(action)) return;
		if ((!resolving && pending.value) || writeStatus.value === 'pending') return;
		const kind = action.kind;
		const row =
			rows.value.find((p) => p.id === action.postId) ??
			(selected.value?.id === action.postId ? selected.value : null);
		if ((!resolving && !row) || !allowed(kind) || (!resolving && !list.resultReady.value))
			return;
		if (
			!resolving &&
			kind === 'comment' &&
			(!action.body.trim() ||
				action.body.length > 10000 ||
				selected.value?.id !== action.postId)
		)
			return;
		if (
			!resolving &&
			kind === 'delete' &&
			(!comments.value.some((c) => c.id === action.commentId && c.canDelete) ||
				selected.value?.id !== action.postId)
		)
			return;
		const operation = resolving
			? pending.value
			: { id: createTemplateId(), action: structuredClone(action) };
		if (!operation || operation.action.postId !== action.postId) return;
		const r = request(
			kind,
			undefined,
			selected.value?.id === action.postId ? action.postId : undefined
		);
		const g = epoch,
			oldDraft = draft.value;
		const current = () => r.current() && pending.value === operation;
		try {
			pending.value = operation;
			if (!current()) return;
			writeError.value = '';
			if (!current()) return;
			writeStatus.value = 'pending';
			if (!current()) return;
			if (resolving) setFeedback('正在核实原操作', 'app.templates.social.verifying');
			else setFeedback('正在提交', 'app.templates.social.submitting');
			if (!current()) return;
			const raw = resolving
				? await r.host.service.resolve(operation.id, r.input)
				: await r.host.service.write(operation, r.input);
			if (!current()) return;
			const result = outcome(raw, action.postId);
			if (!current()) return;
			writeStatus.value = result.status;
			if (!current()) return;
			if (result.status === 'success') {
				const accepted = accept(result.post);
				if (!current()) return;
				if (selected.value?.id === accepted.id) selected.value = accepted;
				if (!current()) return;
				setFeedback('已保存服务权威结果', 'app.templates.social.saved');
				if (!current()) return;
				if (kind === 'comment' && draft.value === oldDraft && oldDraft === action.body)
					draft.value = '';
				if (!current()) return;
				if (
					(kind === 'comment' || kind === 'delete') &&
					selected.value?.id === action.postId
				)
					await loadComments(1);
				if (current()) pending.value = null;
			} else if (result.status === 'failed') {
				writeError.value = result.message;
				if (!current()) return;
				setFeedback('操作未完成，草稿保留，可重试', 'app.templates.social.writeFailed');
				if (current()) pending.value = null;
			} else
				setFeedback(
					'结果未知，请核实原操作；不会自动重发',
					'app.templates.social.writeUnknown'
				);
		} catch {
			if (current()) {
				writeStatus.value = 'unknown';
				if (current())
					setFeedback('结果未知，请核实原操作', 'app.templates.social.verifyUnknown');
			}
		} finally {
			if (
				!disposed &&
				g === epoch &&
				pending.value === operation &&
				writeStatus.value === 'pending'
			)
				writeStatus.value = 'unknown';
			r.release();
		}
	}
	scope.run(() => {
		watch(
			() => [
				getHost().security,
				getHost().service,
				getHost().security.state.value.epoch,
				getHost().security.state.value.status,
				getHost().security.state.value.subject,
				!!getHost().disabled,
				!!getHost().readonly
			],
			() => {
				const g = epoch + 1,
					previous = stopSecurity;
				stopSecurity = () => {};
				previous();
				clear();
				if (epoch !== g || disposed) return;
				const stop = getHost().security.onInvalidate(clear);
				if (epoch !== g || disposed) {
					stop();
					return;
				}
				stopSecurity = stop;
				if (allowed('read') && epoch === g) {
					list.resumeScope({ keyword: '', author: '', bookmarked: false });
					if (epoch === g && allowed('read')) void list.submit();
				}
			},
			{ immediate: true, flush: 'sync' }
		);
	});
	function dispose() {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		stopSecurity();
		clear();
		scope.stop();
		i18n?.dispose();
	}
	return {
		i18n,
		displayFeedback: computed(() =>
			i18n && feedbackSource.value
				? formatFieldIssue(feedbackSource.value, i18n)
				: feedback.value
		),
		displayCommentsError: computed(() =>
			commentsError.value && i18n
				? i18n.t('app.templates.social.commentsFailed')
				: commentsError.value
		),
		list,
		rows,
		selected: readonly(selected),
		comments: readonly(comments),
		commentPage: readonly(commentPage),
		commentTotal: readonly(commentTotal),
		commentsLoading: readonly(commentsLoading),
		commentsError: readonly(commentsError),
		writeError: readonly(writeError),
		draft: draftInput,
		feedback: readonly(feedback),
		writeStatus: readonly(writeStatus),
		pending: readonly(pending),
		allowed,
		open,
		close,
		loadComments,
		write,
		shown: (row: SocialPost) => rows.value.find((p) => p.id === row.id) ?? row,
		resolve: () => (pending.value ? write(pending.value.action, true) : Promise.resolve()),
		cancelDraft: () => {
			if (!disposed && !clearing.value)
				setFeedback('已取消编辑，草稿已保留', 'app.templates.social.draftKept');
		},
		dispose
	};
}
export type SocialController = ReturnType<typeof createSocial>;

<template>
	<AsamConfigProvider :i18n="c.i18n"
		><main class="social-page social-tech" data-theme="dark" :data-size="size ?? 'default'">
			<header class="social-tech-header">
				<div>
					<span>[ OPEN CHANNEL / 03 ]</span>
					<h1>{{ formatSocialCopy('tech', 'title', i18n) }}</h1>
				</div>
				<dl>
					<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.social.identityLabel') }}</dt>
					<dd>
						{{
							host.security.state.value.subject?.name ??
							i18n.t('app.templates.social.offline')
						}}
					</dd>
					<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.social.sessionLabel') }}</dt>
					<dd>{{ formatSecurityStatus(host.security.state.value.status, i18n) }}</dd>
				</dl>
			</header>
			<div class="social-tech-layout">
				<section class="social-tech-stream">
					<header>
						<h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.social.activity') }}</h2>
						<p>{{ formatSocialCopy('tech', 'description', i18n) }}</p>
					</header>
					<SocialFeed :c="c" :size="size" grid />
				</section>
				<aside class="social-tech-inspector">
					<h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.social.readingDesk') }}</h2>
					<p v-if="!c.selected.value">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.social.openHint') }}</p>
					<SocialDetail :c="c" />
					<dl>
						<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.social.result') }}</dt>
						<dd>
							{{
								c.list.page.stale.value
									? i18n.t('app.templates.social.stale')
									: c.list.page.loading.value
										? i18n.t('app.templates.social.pending')
										: i18n.t('app.templates.social.current')
							}}
						</dd>
						<dt>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.social.write') }}</dt>
						<dd>{{ i18n.t(writeStatusKeys[c.writeStatus.value]) }}</dd>
					</dl>
				</aside>
			</div>
		</main></AsamConfigProvider
	>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { formatSecurityStatus } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { SocialPageProps } from './Types.js';
import { formatSocialCopy } from './config.js';
import { useSocialPage } from './useSocialPage.js';
import SocialFeed from './parts/SocialFeed.vue';
import SocialDetail from './parts/SocialDetail.vue';
import './Social.css';
const props = defineProps<SocialPageProps>();
const c = useSocialPage(props);
const i18n = c.i18n;
defineExpose({ controller: c });

const writeStatusKeys = {
	idle: 'app.templates.social.idleWrite',
	pending: 'app.templates.social.pendingWrite',
	success: 'app.templates.social.successWrite',
	failed: 'app.templates.social.failedWrite',
	unknown: 'app.templates.social.unknownWrite'
} as const;

ts
import type { AsamListRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
type SecurityController = ReturnType<typeof createSecurity>;
import type { SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';

export type SocialId = string | number;
export interface SocialAuthor {
	id: SocialId;
	name?: string;
	avatar?: { src: string; alt: string };
}
export interface SocialPost {
	id: SocialId;
	author: SocialAuthor;
	body: string;
	time?: string;
	cover?: { src: string; alt: string };
	liked: boolean;
	likes: number;
	bookmarked: boolean;
	comments: number;
	version: number;
}
export interface SocialComment {
	id: SocialId;
	postId: SocialId;
	author: SocialAuthor;
	body: string;
	time?: string;
	canDelete: boolean;
}
export interface SocialPage<T> {
	list: readonly T[];
	total: number;
}
export interface SocialRequest {
	subject: SecuritySubject;
	signal: AbortSignal;

import type {
	SocialAuthor,
	SocialComment,
	SocialId,
	SocialOutcome,
	SocialPage,
	SocialPost
} from './Types.js';
import type { SocialWrite } from './Types.js';
export const idKey = (id: SocialId) => JSON.stringify([typeof id, id]);
const validId = (id: unknown) =>
	(typeof id === 'number' && Number.isFinite(id)) || (typeof id === 'string' && !!id.trim());
const count = (n: unknown) => typeof n === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n >= 0;
const optionalText = (s: unknown) => s === undefined || typeof s === 'string';
export function validWrite(action: SocialWrite) {
	if (!action || !validId(action.postId)) return false;
	if (action.kind === 'like' || action.kind === 'bookmark')
		return typeof action.desired === 'boolean' && count(action.version);
	if (action.kind === 'comment')
		return (
			typeof action.body === 'string' && !!action.body.trim() && action.body.length <= 10000
		);
	return action.kind === 'delete' && validId(action.commentId);
}
function image(image: { src: string; alt: string } | undefined) {
	if (
		image !== undefined &&
		(!image ||
			typeof image.src !== 'string' ||
			!/^\.?\.?\//.test(image.src) ||
			image.src.startsWith('//') ||
			// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- Reject control characters in local URLs.
			/[\\\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/.test(image.src) ||
			typeof image.alt !== 'string')
	)
		throw Error('图片必须是本地资源及替代文本');
}
function author(a: SocialAuthor) {
	if (!a || !validId(a.id) || !optionalText(a.name)) throw Error('作者数据无效');
	image(a.avatar);
}
export function post(p: SocialPost): SocialPost {
	if (
		!p ||
		!validId(p.id) ||
		typeof p.body !== 'string' ||
		!optionalText(p.time) ||
		typeof p.liked !== 'boolean' ||
		typeof p.bookmarked !== 'boolean' ||
		!count(p.likes) ||
		!count(p.comments) ||
		!count(p.version)
	)
		throw Error('帖子数据无效');
	author(p.author);
	image(p.cover);
	return structuredClone(p);
}
export function comment(c: SocialComment, postId: SocialId): SocialComment {
	if (
		!c ||
		!validId(c.id) ||
		c.postId !== postId ||
		typeof c.body !== 'string' ||
		!optionalText(c.time) ||
		typeof c.canDelete !== 'boolean'
	)
		throw Error('评论数据无效');
	author(c.author);
	return structuredClone(c);
}
export function page<T extends { id: SocialId }>(
	value: SocialPage<T>,
	validate: (row: T) => T
): SocialPage<T> {
	if (
		!value ||
		!Array.isArray(value.list) ||
		!count(value.total) ||
		value.total < value.list.length
	)
		throw Error('分页数据无效');
	const rows = value.list.map(validate),
		keys = rows.map((r) => idKey(r.id));
	if (new Set(keys).size !== keys.length) throw Error('标识重复');
	return { list: rows, total: value.total };
}
export function outcome(value: SocialOutcome, postId: SocialId): SocialOutcome {
	if (!value || !['success', 'failed', 'unknown'].includes(value.status))
		throw Error('操作结果无效');
	if (value.status === 'success') {
		const row = post(value.post);
		if (row.id !== postId) throw Error('操作对象不匹配');
		return { status: 'success', post: row };
	}
	if (value.status === 'failed') {
		const message = value.message;
		if (typeof message !== 'string') throw Error('失败结果无效');
		return { status: 'failed', message };
	}
	return { status: 'unknown' };
}

import {

const websitePreviewControls =

}
function websiteNativeEvent(value: unknown, type: string) {

import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { createDemoSecurity, createEditorialService, createSyntheticService } from './Fixture.js';

const security = createDemoSecurity(i18n);
const fixture = createSyntheticService();
fixture.control = reactive(fixture.control);
// The service closes over the same control object; reactive proxy writes reach that object.
const editorial = createEditorialService(fixture.service);
const family = ref<'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech'>('minimal'),
	size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
const readonly = ref(false),
	disabled = ref(false),
	dark = ref(false),
	mapped = ref(false);
function updateFamily(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'minimal' || value === 'brand' || value === 'tech') family.value = value;
}
function updateSize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'small' || value === 'default' || value === 'big' || value === 'large')
		size.value = value;
}
function updateMode(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'normal' || value === 'failed' || value === 'unknown')
		fixture.control.writeMode = value;
}
function updateBoolean(
	key: 'readonly' | 'disabled' | 'dark' | 'mapped' | 'readFailure',
	value: unknown
) {
	if (typeof value !== 'boolean') return;
	if (key === 'readFailure') fixture.control.readFailure = value;

const pages = { minimal: MinimalSocialPage, brand: BrandSocialPage, tech: TechSocialPage };

onBeforeUnmount(security.dispose);

import { createSecurity, scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { SecurityScope, SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { adaptSocial } from '../Adapter.js';
import { socialPermission } from '../Types.js';
import type {
	SocialComment,
	SocialId,
	SocialOperation,
	SocialOutcome,
	SocialPost,
	SocialRequest,
	SocialService
} from '../Types.js';

const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
const contexts = [
	{ tenant: 0, organization: null, label: '设计讨论' },
	{ tenant: '0', organization: null, label: '工程笔记' }
];
export function createDemoSecurity(i18n?: AsamI18n) {
	let saved: SecuritySubject | null = null;
	const subject = (id: SocialId, scope: SecurityScope = contexts[0]): SecuritySubject => ({
		id,
		name: typeof id === 'number' ? '林序' : '陈知',
		roles: ['member'],
		permissions: Object.values(socialPermission),
		scope,
		contexts,
		expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600000
	});
	return createSecurity<SocialId>({
		i18n,
		adapter: {
			login: async (id, r) => {
				await wait(100);
				const s = subject(id);
				if (r.isCurrent()) saved = s;
				return s;
			},
			restore: async () => {
				await wait(100);
				return saved;
			},
			refresh: async (s) => ({ ...s, expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600000 }),
			switchContext: async (s, target, r) => {
				await wait(100);
				const next = subject(s.id, target);
				if (r.isCurrent()) saved = next;
				return next;
			},
			logout: async (r) => {
				await wait(100);
				if (r.isCurrent()) saved = null;
			}
		}
	});
}
export function makePosts(label: string): SocialPost[] {
	return Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => ({
		id: i === 0 ? 0 : i === 1 ? '0' : `post-${i}`,
		author: {
			id: i % 2 ? '0' : 0,
			name: i % 2 ? '陈知' : '林序',
			...(i % 5 === 0
				? { avatar: { src: './missing-avatar.png', alt: '作者头像' } }
				: i % 3 === 0
					? {
							avatar: {
								src: new URL('../assets/avatar.svg', import.meta.url).pathname,
								alt: '作者头像'
							}
						}
					: {})
		},
		body: `${label} · ${i + 1} / 记录今天的设计与工程\n让细节可以被讨论，也让不同意见有清楚的上下文。\n${i % 4 === 0 ? '长文：'.repeat(120) : 'Small observations become useful shared knowledge.'}\n<script>window.UNSAFE=true</script> <b>纯文本</b> https://example.invalid/ 不自动打开。`,
		time: i % 7 ? `2026-10-19T${String(9 + (i % 10)).padStart(2, '0')}:00:00Z` : undefined,
		...(i % 13 === 0
			? {
					cover: {
						src:
							i % 26 === 0
								? './missing-cover.png'
								: new URL('../assets/cover.svg', import.meta.url).pathname,
						alt: '工作笔记封面'
					}
				}
			: {}),
		liked: false,
		likes: i,
		bookmarked: i % 4 === 0,
		comments: i === 0 ? 40 : 0,
		version: 1
	}));
}

/** In-memory demonstration only. A real server must own authorization, versions and durable idempotency. */
export function createSyntheticService(options: { label?: string; delay?: number } = {}) {
	const control = {
		readFailure: false,
		writeMode: 'normal' as 'normal' | 'failed' | 'unknown',
		failedMessage: '明确未写入',
		ignoreAbort: false,
		calls: [] as { kind: string; at: number; settled?: number }[]
	};
	const stores = new Map<
		string,
		{ posts: SocialPost[]; comments: SocialComment[]; operations: Map<string, SocialOutcome> }
	>();
	function store(r: SocialRequest) {
		const key = scopeKey(r.subject);
		let data = stores.get(key);
		if (!data) {
			const posts = makePosts(
				`${options.label ?? '公共笔记'} / ${typeof r.subject.scope.tenant}:${r.subject.scope.tenant}`
			);
			data = {
				posts,
				comments: Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => ({
					id: i === 0 ? 0 : i === 1 ? '0' : `comment-${i}`,
					postId: 0,
					author: { id: i % 2 ? '0' : 0, name: i % 2 ? '陈知' : '林序' },
					body: `评论 ${i + 1}\n${'具体的反馈与改进记录。'.repeat(i === 0 ? 100 : 2)}\n<b>保留原文</b>`,
					canDelete: (i % 2 ? '0' : 0) === r.subject.id
				})),
				operations: new Map()
			};
			stores.set(key, data);
		}
		return data;
	}
	async function gate(r: SocialRequest, kind: keyof typeof socialPermission) {
		const call: { kind: string; at: number; settled?: number } = {
			kind,
			at: performance.now()
		};
		control.calls.push(call);
		try {
			await wait(options.delay ?? 100);
		} finally {
			call.settled = performance.now();
		}
		if (
			(!control.ignoreAbort && r.signal.aborted) ||
			!r.isCurrent() ||
			!r.subject.permissions.includes(socialPermission[kind]) ||
			(kind !== 'read' && kind !== 'comments' && r.subject.readOnly)
		)
			throw Error('服务授权已失效');
	}
	const service: SocialService = {
		feed: async (q, r) => {
			await gate(r, 'read');
			if (control.readFailure) throw Error('合成读取失败');
			let rows = store(r).posts.filter(
				(p) =>
					p.body.toLowerCase().includes(String(q.query.keyword ?? '').toLowerCase()) &&
					(q.query.author === '' ||
						q.query.author === undefined ||
						p.author.id === q.query.author) &&
					(!q.query.bookmarked || p.bookmarked)
			);
			rows = [...rows].sort(
				(a, b) =>
					(q.sort?.field === 'likes'
						? a.likes - b.likes
						: store(r).posts.indexOf(a) - store(r).posts.indexOf(b)) *
					(q.sort?.order === 'descending' ? -1 : 1)
			);
			return structuredClone({
				total: rows.length,
				list: rows.slice((q.currentPage - 1) * q.pageSize, q.currentPage * q.pageSize)
			});
		},
		comments: async (id, n, size, r) => {
			await gate(r, 'comments');
			if (control.readFailure) throw Error('合成读取失败');
			const rows = store(r).comments.filter((c) => c.postId === id);
			return structuredClone({
				total: rows.length,
				list: rows.slice((n - 1) * size, n * size)
			});
		},
		write: async (op, r) => {
			await gate(r, op.action.kind);
			const data = store(r),
				known = data.operations.get(op.id);
			if (known) return structuredClone(known);
			if (control.writeMode === 'failed')
				return { status: 'failed', message: control.failedMessage };
			const action = op.action,
				row = data.posts.find((p) => p.id === action.postId);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failed', message: '帖子不存在' };
			if (action.kind === 'like' || action.kind === 'bookmark') {
				if (action.version !== row.version)
					return { status: 'failed', message: '版本冲突，请刷新' };
				if (action.kind === 'like') {
					row.likes += Number(action.desired) - Number(row.liked);
					row.liked = action.desired;
				} else row.bookmarked = action.desired;
			} else if (action.kind === 'comment') {
				if (!action.body.trim() || action.body.length > 10000)
					return { status: 'failed', message: '评论无效' };
				data.comments.unshift({
					id: `new-${op.id}`,
					postId: row.id,
					author: { id: r.subject.id, name: r.subject.name },
					body: action.body,
					canDelete: true
				});
				row.comments++;
			} else if (action.kind === 'delete') {
				const index = data.comments.findIndex(
					(c) =>
						c.id === action.commentId &&
						c.postId === row.id &&
						c.author.id === r.subject.id &&
						c.canDelete
				);
				if (index < 0) return { status: 'failed', message: '不可删除' };
				data.comments.splice(index, 1);
				row.comments--;
			}
			row.version++;
			const result: SocialOutcome = { status: 'success', post: structuredClone(row) };
			data.operations.set(op.id, result);
			return control.writeMode === 'unknown'
				? { status: 'unknown' }
				: structuredClone(result);
		},
		resolve: async (id, r) => {
			await gate(r, 'read');
			return structuredClone(store(r).operations.get(id) ?? { status: 'unknown' });
		}
	};
	return { service, control };
}

export interface EditorialDTO {
	key: SocialId;
	person: SocialPost['author'];
	text: string;
	stamp?: string;
	art?: SocialPost['cover'];
	stats: { hearts: number; replies: number };
	viewer: { heart: boolean; saved: boolean };
	revision: number;
}
export interface NoteDTO {
	key: SocialId;
	parent: SocialId;
	writer: SocialComment['author'];
	text: string;
	removable: boolean;
	stamp?: string;
}
export const toEditorial = (p: SocialPost): EditorialDTO => ({
	key: p.id,
	person: p.author,
	text: p.body,
	stamp: p.time,
	art: p.cover,
	stats: { hearts: p.likes, replies: p.comments },
	viewer: { heart: p.liked, saved: p.bookmarked },
	revision: p.version
});
export const editorialMapping = {
	post: (p: EditorialDTO): SocialPost => ({
		id: p.key,
		author: p.person,
		body: p.text,
		time: p.stamp,
		cover: p.art,
		likes: p.stats.hearts,
		comments: p.stats.replies,
		liked: p.viewer.heart,
		bookmarked: p.viewer.saved,
		version: p.revision
	}),
	comment: (c: NoteDTO): SocialComment => ({
		id: c.key,
		postId: c.parent,
		author: c.writer,
		body: c.text,
		canDelete: c.removable,
		time: c.stamp
	})
};
/** A genuinely different transport DTO travels through both read and write paths. */
export function createEditorialService(base: SocialService): SocialService {
	const result = (o: SocialOutcome) =>
		o.status === 'success' ? { status: o.status, post: toEditorial(o.post) } : o;
	return adaptSocial<EditorialDTO, NoteDTO>(
		{
			feed: async (q, r) => {
				const p = await base.feed(q, r);
				return { total: p.total, list: p.list.map(toEditorial) };
			},
			comments: async (id, n, s, r) => {
				const p = await base.comments(id, n, s, r);
				return {
					total: p.total,
					list: p.list.map((c) => ({
						key: c.id,
						parent: c.postId,
						writer: c.author,
						text: c.body,
						removable: c.canDelete,
						stamp: c.time
					}))
				};
			},
			write: async (op: SocialOperation, r) => result(await base.write(op, r)),
			resolve: async (id, r) => result(await base.resolve(id, r))
		},
		editorialMapping
	);
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamTextarea } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { useSocialI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useSocialI18n();
import { computed, nextTick, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import type { SocialController } from '../Social.js';
import type { SocialId } from '../Types.js';
import { idKey } from '../Validation.js';
const props = defineProps<{ c: SocialController }>();
const draft = computed({
	get: () => props.c.draft.value,
	set(value: string) {
		// eslint-disable-next-line vue/no-mutating-props -- Public writable controller draft, as before.
		props.c.draft.value = value;
	}
});
const confirmId = ref<SocialId | null>(null),
	composing = ref(false),
	panel = ref<HTMLElement>();
watch([() => props.c.selected.value?.id, () => props.c.list.session.value], async () => {
	confirmId.value = null;
	composing.value = false;
	await nextTick();
	panel.value?.focus();
});
function updateDraft(value: string | number) {
	draft.value = String(value);
}
function close() {
	props.c.close();
	const element = Reflect.get(props.c, 'returnFocus');
	void nextTick(() => {
		if (element instanceof HTMLElement && element.isConnected) element.focus();
	});
}
function submit() {
	if (!composing.value && props.c.selected.value)
		void props.c.write({
			kind: 'comment',
			postId: props.c.selected.value.id,
			body: props.c.draft.value
		});
}
function remove() {
	const id = confirmId.value;
	confirmId.value = null;
	if (id !== null && props.c.selected.value)
		void props.c.write({ kind: 'delete', postId: props.c.selected.value.id, commentId: id });
}
</script>

	StarFilled

const initial = { keyword: '', author: 'all', bookmarked: false };
const draft = ref<AsamFieldModel>({ ...initial });

		modes: { query: { componentProps: { name: 'keyword' } } }

	{
		key: 'author',
		kind: 'single',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.social.author'),
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: [
				{ value: 'all', label: i18n.t('app.templates.social.allAuthors') },
				{ value: 'number', label: '林序 · 数字0' },
				{ value: 'string', label: '陈知 · 字符串0' }
			]
		}),
		query: (value) => (value === 'number' ? 0 : value === 'string' ? '0' : '')
	},
	{
		key: 'bookmarked',
		kind: 'custom',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.social.onlyBookmarks'),
		control: bookmarkControl,
		isValue: (value) => typeof value === 'boolean',
		emptyValue: () => false,
		isEmpty: () => false,
		query: (value) => value,
		submit: (value) => value,
		format: (value) => String(value)
	}

function expandedAttributes(value: boolean): Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'aria-expanded'> {

watch(

	{ field: 'likes', order: 'ascending' },
	{ field: 'likes', order: 'descending' }

const toolbarDisabled = computed(
	() =>
		!props.c.allowed('read') ||
		!props.c.list.scopeReady.value ||
		props.c.list.page.loading.value
);
const tools = computed<readonly ListToolbarTool[]>(() => [
	{
		id: 'sort',
		label:
			i18n.t('pro.list.cards.sort') +
			' · ' +
			i18n.t(
				likesOrder.value === 'ascending'
					? 'app.templates.social.fewestLikes'
					: likesOrder.value === 'descending'
						? 'app.templates.social.mostLikes'
						: 'app.templates.social.recordOrder'
			),
		icon:
			likesOrder.value === 'ascending'
				? Top
				: likesOrder.value === 'descending'
					? Bottom
					: Sort,
		disabled: toolbarDisabled.value || !props.c.list.intent.value,
		pressed: !!likesOrder.value,
		state: likesOrder.value ? undefined : 'default-sort'

	{
		id: 'refresh',

		disabled: toolbarDisabled.value

function runTool(id: string) {
	if (toolbarDisabled.value) return;
	if (id === 'sort' && props.c.list.intent.value)
		void props.c.list.setSort(
			likesOrder.value === 'descending' ? null : likesSort[likesOrder.value ? 1 : 0]

	if (id === 'refresh') void props.c.list.refresh();
}
const content = (): AsamListContent => ({ title: '' });
function search(query: AsamFieldModel) {

	props.c.list.setDraft({ keyword: '', ...query });
	void props.c.list.submit();
}
function expand(row: SocialPost) {
	const set = new Set(expanded.value),
		key = idKey(row.id);
	if (set.has(key)) set.delete(key);
	else set.add(key);
	expanded.value = set;
}
function likeLabel(row: SocialPost) {
	return i18n.t(
		props.c.shown(row).liked ? 'app.templates.social.unlike' : 'app.templates.social.like'
	);
}
function bookmarkLabel(row: SocialPost) {
	return i18n.t(

			? 'app.templates.social.unbookmark'
			: 'app.templates.social.bookmark'
	);
}
function toggle(kind: 'like' | 'bookmark', row: SocialPost) {
	const post = props.c.shown(row);
	void props.c.write({
		kind,
		postId: row.id,
		desired: kind === 'like' ? !post.liked : !post.bookmarked,
		version: post.version
	});
}
function blocked(kind: 'like' | 'bookmark') {
	return !props.c.allowed(kind) || !!props.c.pending.value || !props.c.list.resultReady.value;
}
function open(row: SocialPost) {
	// eslint-disable-next-line vue/no-mutating-props -- Existing page-owned controller focus handoff.
	Object.assign(props.c, { returnFocus: document.activeElement });
	void props.c.open(row);
}

import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from '../templates/social/examples/App.vue';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(element, onError, i18n) {
	const apps = [];
	const createApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};
	const application = createApp(App);
	const view = application.mount(element);
	if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('test'))
		Object.assign(window, { socialDemo: { view, application } });
	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

let sequence = 0;
let fallbackPrefix;
/** 模板的操作关联ID和行键；不依赖DOM或安全上下文，也不用于安全凭据。 */
export function createTemplateId() {
	const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
	if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
	if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues === 'function') {
		const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
		bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
		bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
		const hex = [...bytes].map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
		return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
	}
	// 无Web Crypto的SSR宿主仍能创建本模块内独立关联键，不在导入时访问浏览器对象。
	fallbackPrefix ??= `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
	return `asam-${fallbackPrefix}-${(++sequence).toString(36)}`;
}

				v-for="tool in actions"
				:key="tool.id"
				class="template-list-toolbar-icon"
				type="primary"
				:text="!tool.pressed"
				:size="size"
				:icon="tool.icon"
				:disabled="tool.disabled"
				:aria-disabled="tool.ariaDisabled || undefined"
				:aria-pressed="tool.pressed"
				:aria-label="tool.label"
				:title="tool.label"
				:data-state="tool.state"
				@click="activate(tool)"
			/>

</template>
<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { FullScreen, Grid, List, Plus, ScaleToOriginal } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
const props = defineProps({
	label: { type: String, required: true },
	summary: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	createLabel: { type: String, required: false },
	createDisabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	tools: { type: Array, required: false },
	viewDisabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	wide: { type: Boolean, required: false, default: undefined },
	layout: { type: String, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['create', 'action', 'update:wide', 'update:layout']);
const i18n = useAsamProI18n();
const labels = computed(() =>
	i18n.locale.value.startsWith('en')
		? {
				shrink: 'Use constrained width',
				widen: 'Use full width',
				horizontal: 'Switch to horizontal layout',
				vertical: 'Switch to vertical layout'
			}
		: {
				shrink: '切为窄版',
				widen: '铺满内容区',
				horizontal: '切为横向排列',
				vertical: '切为纵向排列'
			}
);
const actions = computed(() => {
	const items = [...(props.tools ?? [])];
	if (props.wide !== undefined) {
		items.push({
			id: 'width',
			label: props.wide ? labels.value.shrink : labels.value.widen,
			icon: props.wide ? ScaleToOriginal : FullScreen,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: props.wide
		});
	}
	if (props.layout) {
		const vertical = props.layout === 'list';
		items.push({
			id: 'layout',
			label: vertical ? labels.value.horizontal : labels.value.vertical,
			icon: vertical ? Grid : List,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: vertical
		});
	}
	return items;
});
function activate(tool) {
	if (tool.disabled || tool.ariaDisabled) return;
	if (tool.id === 'width' && props.wide !== undefined) emit('update:wide', !props.wide);
	else if (tool.id === 'layout' && props.layout)
		emit('update:layout', props.layout === 'list' ? 'grid' : 'list');
	else emit('action', tool.id);
}
</script>

/** Replace transport and both explicit DTO mappings; no package-source alias or service singleton. */
export function adaptSocial(transport, mapping) {
	const result = (value) =>
		value.status === 'success' ? { status: 'success', post: mapping.post(value.post) } : value;
	return {
		feed: async (q, r) => {
			const p = await transport.feed(q, r);
			return { total: p.total, list: p.list.map(mapping.post) };
		},
		comments: async (id, n, s, r) => {
			const p = await transport.comments(id, n, s, r);
			return { total: p.total, list: p.list.map(mapping.comment) };
		},
		write: async (op, r) => result(await transport.write(op, r)),
		resolve: async (id, r) => result(await transport.resolve(id, r))
	};
}

import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createAsamMessageIssue, formatFieldIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { socialMessageDefaults } from './I18n.js';
import { createTemplateId } from '../shared/Id.js';
import { computed, effectScope, readonly, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { comment, idKey, outcome, page, post, validWrite } from './Validation.js';
import { socialPermission } from './Types.js';
/** Owns only this page's runtime, reads, drafts and operation. Borrowed hosts are never disposed. */
export function createSocial(getHost, owner) {
	const i18n = owner ? extendAsamI18n(owner, socialMessageDefaults) : undefined;
	const feedbackSource = shallowRef();
	function setFeedback(legacy, ...call) {
		feedback.value = legacy;
		feedbackSource.value = call.length ? createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call) : undefined;
	}
	const scope = effectScope();
	let disposed = false,
		epoch = 0,
		selection = 0,
		commentRun = 0;
	const aborts = new Set();
	const clearing = ref(false);
	const authoritative = new Map();
	const revision = ref(0);
	const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({ scope: 'social-page' });
	const selected = shallowRef(null);
	const comments = shallowRef([]);
	const commentPage = ref(1),
		commentTotal = ref(0),
		commentsLoading = ref(false);
	const commentsError = ref(''),
		writeError = ref(''),
		feedback = ref(''),
		draft = ref('');
	const pending = shallowRef(null);
	const writeStatus = ref('idle');
	let stopSecurity = () => {};
	const allowed = (kind) => {
		if (disposed || clearing.value) return false;
		const h = getHost();
		return (
			!disposed &&
			!h.disabled &&
			(!(kind !== 'read' && kind !== 'comments') || !h.readonly) &&
			h.security.check({
				permission: socialPermission[kind],
				write: kind !== 'read' && kind !== 'comments'
			}) === 'allowed'
		);
	};
	const draftInput = computed({
		get: () => draft.value,
		set: (value) => {
			if (typeof value === 'string' && selected.value && allowed('comment'))
				draft.value = value;
		}
	});
	function request(kind, signal, object) {
		const h = getHost(),
			g = epoch,
			s = selection;
		const subject = h.security.state.value.subject;
		if (!subject || !allowed(kind)) throw Error('当前会话无权操作');
		const key = scopeKey(subject),
			controller = new AbortController();
		aborts.add(controller);
		const cancel = () => controller.abort();
		signal?.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
		if (signal?.aborted) cancel();
		const current = () => {
			const latest = getHost();
			return (
				!disposed &&
				epoch === g &&
				latest.security === h.security &&
				latest.service === h.service &&
				!controller.signal.aborted &&
				allowed(kind) &&
				latest.security.state.value.subject !== null &&
				scopeKey(latest.security.state.value.subject) === key &&
				(object === undefined || (selection === s && selected.value?.id === object))
			);
		};
		const input = { subject, signal: controller.signal, isCurrent: current };
		return {
			host: h,
			input,
			current,
			release: () => {
				signal?.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
				aborts.delete(controller);
			}
		};
	}
	function accept(row) {
		const key = idKey(row.id),
			known = authoritative.get(key);
		if (!known || known.version <= row.version) {
			authoritative.set(key, row);
			revision.value++;
		}
		return authoritative.get(key);
	}

export const idKey = (id) => JSON.stringify([typeof id, id]);

	if (

		typeof p.bookmarked !== 'boolean' ||
		!count(p.likes) ||
		!count(p.comments) ||

import { createSecurity, scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { adaptSocial } from '../Adapter.js';
import { socialPermission } from '../Types.js';
const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
const contexts = [
	{ tenant: 0, organization: null, label: '设计讨论' },
	{ tenant: '0', organization: null, label: '工程笔记' }
];
export function createDemoSecurity(i18n) {
	let saved = null;
	const subject = (id, scope = contexts[0]) => ({
		id,
		name: typeof id === 'number' ? '林序' : '陈知',
		roles: ['member'],
		permissions: Object.values(socialPermission),
		scope,
		contexts,
		expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600000
	});
	return createSecurity({
		i18n,
		adapter: {
			login: async (id, r) => {
				await wait(100);
				const s = subject(id);
				if (r.isCurrent()) saved = s;
				return s;
			},
			restore: async () => {
				await wait(100);
				return saved;
			},
			refresh: async (s) => ({ ...s, expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600000 }),
			switchContext: async (s, target, r) => {
				await wait(100);
				const next = subject(s.id, target);
				if (r.isCurrent()) saved = next;
				return next;
			},
			logout: async (r) => {
				await wait(100);
				if (r.isCurrent()) saved = null;
			}
		}
	});
}
export function makePosts(label) {
	return Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => ({
		id: i === 0 ? 0 : i === 1 ? '0' : `post-${i}`,
		author: {
			id: i % 2 ? '0' : 0,
			name: i % 2 ? '陈知' : '林序',
			...(i % 5 === 0
				? { avatar: { src: './missing-avatar.png', alt: '作者头像' } }
				: i % 3 === 0
					? {
							avatar: {
								src: new URL('../assets/avatar.svg', import.meta.url).pathname,
								alt: '作者头像'
							}
						}
					: {})
		},
		body: `${label} · ${i + 1} / 记录今天的设计与工程\n让细节可以被讨论，也让不同意见有清楚的上下文。\n${i % 4 === 0 ? '长文：'.repeat(120) : 'Small observations become useful shared knowledge.'}\n<script>window.UNSAFE=true</script> <b>纯文本</b> https://example.invalid/ 不自动打开。`,
		time: i % 7 ? `2026-10-19T${String(9 + (i % 10)).padStart(2, '0')}:00:00Z` : undefined,
		...(i % 13 === 0
			? {
					cover: {
						src:
							i % 26 === 0
								? './missing-cover.png'
								: new URL('../assets/cover.svg', import.meta.url).pathname,
						alt: '工作笔记封面'
					}
				}
			: {}),
		liked: false,
		likes: i,
		bookmarked: i % 4 === 0,
		comments: i === 0 ? 40 : 0,
		version: 1
	}));
}
/** In-memory demonstration only. A real server must own authorization, versions and durable idempotency. */
export function createSyntheticService(options = {}) {
	const control = {
		readFailure: false,
		writeMode: 'normal',
		failedMessage: '明确未写入',
		ignoreAbort: false,
		calls: []
	};
	const stores = new Map();
	function store(r) {
		const key = scopeKey(r.subject);
		let data = stores.get(key);
		if (!data) {
			const posts = makePosts(
				`${options.label ?? '公共笔记'} / ${typeof r.subject.scope.tenant}:${r.subject.scope.tenant}`
			);
			data = {
				posts,
				comments: Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => ({
					id: i === 0 ? 0 : i === 1 ? '0' : `comment-${i}`,
					postId: 0,
					author: { id: i % 2 ? '0' : 0, name: i % 2 ? '陈知' : '林序' },
					body: `评论 ${i + 1}\n${'具体的反馈与改进记录。'.repeat(i === 0 ? 100 : 2)}\n<b>保留原文</b>`,
					canDelete: (i % 2 ? '0' : 0) === r.subject.id
				})),
				operations: new Map()
			};
			stores.set(key, data);
		}
		return data;
	}
	async function gate(r, kind) {
		const call = {
			kind,
			at: performance.now()
		};
		control.calls.push(call);
		try {
			await wait(options.delay ?? 100);
		} finally {
			call.settled = performance.now();
		}
		if (
			(!control.ignoreAbort && r.signal.aborted) ||
			!r.isCurrent() ||
			!r.subject.permissions.includes(socialPermission[kind]) ||
			(kind !== 'read' && kind !== 'comments' && r.subject.readOnly)
		)
			throw Error('服务授权已失效');
	}
	const service = {
		feed: async (q, r) => {
			await gate(r, 'read');
			if (control.readFailure) throw Error('合成读取失败');
			let rows = store(r).posts.filter(
				(p) =>
					p.body.toLowerCase().includes(String(q.query.keyword ?? '').toLowerCase()) &&
					(q.query.author === '' ||
						q.query.author === undefined ||
						p.author.id === q.query.author) &&
					(!q.query.bookmarked || p.bookmarked)
			);
			rows = [...rows].sort(
				(a, b) =>
					(q.sort?.field === 'likes'
						? a.likes - b.likes
						: store(r).posts.indexOf(a) - store(r).posts.indexOf(b)) *
					(q.sort?.order === 'descending' ? -1 : 1)
			);
			return structuredClone({
				total: rows.length,
				list: rows.slice((q.currentPage - 1) * q.pageSize, q.currentPage * q.pageSize)
			});
		},
		comments: async (id, n, size, r) => {
			await gate(r, 'comments');
			if (control.readFailure) throw Error('合成读取失败');
			const rows = store(r).comments.filter((c) => c.postId === id);
			return structuredClone({
				total: rows.length,
				list: rows.slice((n - 1) * size, n * size)
			});
		},
		write: async (op, r) => {
			await gate(r, op.action.kind);
			const data = store(r),
				known = data.operations.get(op.id);
			if (known) return structuredClone(known);
			if (control.writeMode === 'failed')
				return { status: 'failed', message: control.failedMessage };
			const action = op.action,
				row = data.posts.find((p) => p.id === action.postId);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failed', message: '帖子不存在' };
			if (action.kind === 'like' || action.kind === 'bookmark') {
				if (action.version !== row.version)
					return { status: 'failed', message: '版本冲突，请刷新' };
				if (action.kind === 'like') {
					row.likes += Number(action.desired) - Number(row.liked);
					row.liked = action.desired;
				} else row.bookmarked = action.desired;
			} else if (action.kind === 'comment') {
				if (!action.body.trim() || action.body.length > 10000)
					return { status: 'failed', message: '评论无效' };
				data.comments.unshift({
					id: `new-${op.id}`,
					postId: row.id,
					author: { id: r.subject.id, name: r.subject.name },
					body: action.body,
					canDelete: true
				});
				row.comments++;
			} else if (action.kind === 'delete') {
				const index = data.comments.findIndex(
					(c) =>
						c.id === action.commentId &&
						c.postId === row.id &&
						c.author.id === r.subject.id &&
						c.canDelete
				);
				if (index < 0) return { status: 'failed', message: '不可删除' };
				data.comments.splice(index, 1);
				row.comments--;
			}
			row.version++;
			const result = { status: 'success', post: structuredClone(row) };
			data.operations.set(op.id, result);
			return control.writeMode === 'unknown'
				? { status: 'unknown' }
				: structuredClone(result);
		},
		resolve: async (id, r) => {
			await gate(r, 'read');
			return structuredClone(store(r).operations.get(id) ?? { status: 'unknown' });
		}
	};
	return { service, control };
}
export const toEditorial = (p) => ({
	key: p.id,
	person: p.author,
	text: p.body,
	stamp: p.time,
	art: p.cover,
	stats: { hearts: p.likes, replies: p.comments },
	viewer: { heart: p.liked, saved: p.bookmarked },
	revision: p.version
});
export const editorialMapping = {
	post: (p) => ({
		id: p.key,
		author: p.person,
		body: p.text,
		time: p.stamp,
		cover: p.art,
		likes: p.stats.hearts,
		comments: p.stats.replies,
		liked: p.viewer.heart,
		bookmarked: p.viewer.saved,
		version: p.revision
	}),
	comment: (c) => ({
		id: c.key,
		postId: c.parent,
		author: c.writer,
		body: c.text,
		canDelete: c.removable,
		time: c.stamp
	})
};
/** A genuinely different transport DTO travels through both read and write paths. */
export function createEditorialService(base) {
	const result = (o) =>
		o.status === 'success' ? { status: o.status, post: toEditorial(o.post) } : o;
	return adaptSocial(
		{
			feed: async (q, r) => {
				const p = await base.feed(q, r);
				return { total: p.total, list: p.list.map(toEditorial) };
			},
			comments: async (id, n, s, r) => {
				const p = await base.comments(id, n, s, r);
				return {
					total: p.total,
					list: p.list.map((c) => ({
						key: c.id,
						parent: c.postId,
						writer: c.author,
						text: c.body,
						removable: c.canDelete,
						stamp: c.time
					}))
				};
			},
			write: async (op, r) => result(await base.write(op, r)),
			resolve: async (id, r) => result(await base.resolve(id, r))
		},
		editorialMapping
	);
}

import { AsamTextarea } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useSocialI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useSocialI18n();
import { computed, nextTick, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { idKey } from '../Validation.js';
const props = defineProps({
	c: { type: null, required: true }
});
const draft = computed({
	get: () => props.c.draft.value,
	set(value) {
		// eslint-disable-next-line vue/no-mutating-props -- Public writable controller draft, as before.
		props.c.draft.value = value;
	}
});
const confirmId = ref(null),
	composing = ref(false),
	panel = ref();
watch([() => props.c.selected.value?.id, () => props.c.list.session.value], async () => {
	confirmId.value = null;
	composing.value = false;
	await nextTick();
	panel.value?.focus();
});
function updateDraft(value) {
	draft.value = String(value);
}
function close() {
	props.c.close();
	const element = Reflect.get(props.c, 'returnFocus');
	void nextTick(() => {
		if (element instanceof HTMLElement && element.isConnected) element.focus();
	});
}
function submit() {
	if (!composing.value && props.c.selected.value)
		void props.c.write({
			kind: 'comment',
			postId: props.c.selected.value.id,
			body: props.c.draft.value
		});
}
function remove() {
	const id = confirmId.value;
	confirmId.value = null;
	if (id !== null && props.c.selected.value)
		void props.c.write({ kind: 'delete', postId: props.c.selected.value.id, commentId: id });
}
</script>

<script setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamCheckboxItem, defineAsamControl, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import {
	Bottom,
	Top,
	ChatDotRound,
	Pointer,
	Refresh,
	Sort,
	Star,
	StarFilled
} from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamProList, AsamSearchForm } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import ListToolbar from '../../shared/ListToolbar.vue';
import '../../shared/ListSurfaces.css';
import { useSocialI18n } from '../I18n.js';
import { idKey } from '../Validation.js';
import SocialImage from './SocialImage.vue';
const props = defineProps({
	c: { type: null, required: true },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	grid: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const i18n = useSocialI18n();
const wide = ref(true);
const layout = ref(props.grid ? 'grid' : 'list');
const initial = { keyword: '', author: 'all', bookmarked: false };
const draft = ref({ ...initial });
const expanded = ref(new Set());
const bookmarkControl = defineAsamControl({
	component: AsamCheckboxItem,
	emptyValue: () => false,
	sourceKinds: []
});
const fields = computed(() => [
	{
		key: 'keyword',
		kind: 'text',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.social.keyword'),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { name: 'keyword' } } }
	},
	{
		key: 'author',
		kind: 'single',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.social.author'),
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: [
				{ value: 'all', label: i18n.t('app.templates.social.allAuthors') },
				{ value: 'number', label: '林序 · 数字0' },
				{ value: 'string', label: '陈知 · 字符串0' }
			]
		}),
		query: (value) => (value === 'number' ? 0 : value === 'string' ? '0' : '')
	},
	{
		key: 'bookmarked',
		kind: 'custom',
		label: i18n.t('app.templates.social.onlyBookmarks'),
		control: bookmarkControl,
		isValue: (value) => typeof value === 'boolean',
		emptyValue: () => false,
		isEmpty: () => false,
		query: (value) => value,
		submit: (value) => value,
		format: (value) => String(value)
	}
]);
function expandedAttributes(value) {
	return { 'aria-expanded': value };
}
watch(
	() => props.c.list.session.value,
	() => {
		draft.value = { ...initial };
		expanded.value = new Set();
	}
);
const likesSort = [
	{ field: 'likes', order: 'ascending' },
	{ field: 'likes', order: 'descending' }
];
const likesOrder = computed(() => {
	const sort = props.c.list.intent.value?.sort;
	return sort?.field === 'likes' ? sort.order : undefined;
});
const toolbarDisabled = computed(
	() =>
		!props.c.allowed('read') ||
		!props.c.list.scopeReady.value ||
		props.c.list.page.loading.value
);
const tools = computed(() => [
	{
		id: 'sort',
		label:
			i18n.t('pro.list.cards.sort') +
			' · ' +
			i18n.t(
				likesOrder.value === 'ascending'
					? 'app.templates.social.fewestLikes'
					: likesOrder.value === 'descending'
						? 'app.templates.social.mostLikes'
						: 'app.templates.social.recordOrder'
			),
		icon:
			likesOrder.value === 'ascending'
				? Top
				: likesOrder.value === 'descending'
					? Bottom
					: Sort,
		disabled: toolbarDisabled.value || !props.c.list.intent.value,
		pressed: !!likesOrder.value,
		state: likesOrder.value ? undefined : 'default-sort'
	},
	{
		id: 'refresh',
		label: i18n.t('pro.table.editing.refresh'),
		icon: Refresh,
		disabled: toolbarDisabled.value
	}
]);
function runTool(id) {
	if (toolbarDisabled.value) return;
	if (id === 'sort' && props.c.list.intent.value)
		void props.c.list.setSort(
			likesOrder.value === 'descending' ? null : likesSort[likesOrder.value ? 1 : 0]
		);
	if (id === 'refresh') void props.c.list.refresh();
}
const content = () => ({ title: '' });
function search(query) {
	if (!props.c.allowed('read')) return;
	props.c.list.setDraft({ keyword: '', ...query });
	void props.c.list.submit();
}
function expand(row) {
	const set = new Set(expanded.value),
		key = idKey(row.id);
	if (set.has(key)) set.delete(key);
	else set.add(key);
	expanded.value = set;
}
function likeLabel(row) {
	return i18n.t(
		props.c.shown(row).liked ? 'app.templates.social.unlike' : 'app.templates.social.like'
	);
}
function bookmarkLabel(row) {
	return i18n.t(
		props.c.shown(row).bookmarked
			? 'app.templates.social.unbookmark'
			: 'app.templates.social.bookmark'
	);
}
function toggle(kind, row) {
	const post = props.c.shown(row);
	void props.c.write({
		kind,
		postId: row.id,
		desired: kind === 'like' ? !post.liked : !post.bookmarked,
		version: post.version
	});
}
function blocked(kind) {
	return !props.c.allowed(kind) || !!props.c.pending.value || !props.c.list.resultReady.value;
}
function open(row) {
	// eslint-disable-next-line vue/no-mutating-props -- Existing page-owned controller focus handoff.
	Object.assign(props.c, { returnFocus: document.activeElement });
	void props.c.open(row);
}
</script>
